posts.zh:
dsh-pets 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ff9d2275a7e66385f57a.html
posts.en:
dsh-pets is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ff9d2275a7e66385f57a.html
